May contain spoilers from Sky King's Tomb **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 79 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Activate**Interact --- A mixture of [fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119) blood and rare ingredients give you incredible speed but also cause you to become particularly attractive to predators. **Benefit** You gain a status bonus to your speed and are able to use the following reaction:
**Timely Dodge** **Trigger** You are targeted by a Strike; **Effect** You dart aside, gaining a circumstance bonus to AC, then Step after the Strike resolves. **Drawback** The range at which creatures can detect you with [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) or [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) doubles. [Animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) and [beasts](/Traits.aspx?ID=20) gain a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against you. Prey Mutagen (Lesser) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 79 **Price** 4 gp **Bulk** L --- You gain a +10 status bonus to your Speed and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC when using Timely Dodge. The duration is 1 minute. Prey Mutagen (Moderate) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 79 **Price** 12 gp **Bulk** L --- You gain a +20 status bonus to your Speed and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC when using Timely Dodge. The duration is 10 minutes. Prey Mutagen (Greater) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 79 **Price** 300 gp **Bulk** L --- You gain a +30 status bonus to your Speed and gain a +3 circumstance bonus to AC when using Timely Dodge. The duration is 1 hour. Prey Mutagen (Major) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 79 **Price** 3,000 gp **Bulk** L --- You gain a +40 status bonus to your Speed and gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC when using Timely Dodge. The duration is 1 hour.
